policy.admission: research-only; candidate registration is not adoption, runtime readiness, or DoE admission
policy.reuse: reuse existing repository integrations and evidence; no duplicate control plane or integration work
policy.comparison: compare candidates by role; simulation engines are not scored as orchestration frameworks
policy.doe: a DoE campaign joins the family only after a committed design record and EXPERIMENT-conforming run evidence
policy.source: official upstream sources first; pin source SHA/tag, license and dependencies before implementation
safety: no paid provider calls by default
simulation outputs are not factual corpus evidence
